description: This Java class 'FtpServices' provides FTP-related services such as uploading ('putFile') and downloading ('getFile') files via FTP protocol within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages FTP connections, handles errors, and supports configurations like passive mode and binary transfer.

classes.name: FtpServices
classes.description: Provides FTP upload and download services within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: putFile
methods.description: Uploads a local file to a remote FTP server, handling connection setup, login, file transfer, and optional site commands.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Downloads a remote file from an FTP server to a local file, managing connection, login, and transfer settings.
